selection: User accepted after development OOF review; no new independent test after final specification choice
s_and_lambda: MLE along reconstructed paths; fitted within each training set
boundary: Choose mean_velocity or fit_positions from fit-match forward 3D error after .6s; equal match weights
integration: Competing-control exponential Euler; log-domain likelihood; no cutoff/floor in fit

hypothetical_flight.radius: exact target distance, no radial lookup
hypothetical_flight.receiver: teammate nearest to target at release

calibration: Isotonic on nested match-held-out PPCF scores within each outer training set

cohort.endpoint_policy: Immediate matched raw neighbor; continuous observed XY; identified completed reception or opponent recovery; no interruption
cohort.passers: Outfield only; goalkeepers retained in player states and as receivers

operational_weights: Verified run41 full-data trajectory MLE; final isotonic fitted to run41 outer cross-fitted raw PPCF scores
limitations: No ball spin/Magnus, bounce or rolling friction fit
Observed recovery is a proxy target for failed passes, not known intention
Centred tracking velocity smoothing makes this an offline study
Ten matches used in development; external evaluation remains open
Five initial positions span0..0.4s; centred velocities can depend on positions through0.6s
Passes shorter than0.5s need an adapted boundary estimator and remain a future extension
Isotonic can produce exact0/1 endpoints; rare mistakes are strongly penalized by log-loss
tti_locations: Receiver arrival for hypothetical flight selection

optimizer.learning_rate: No fixed rate; BFGS line search
optimizer.selection: Lowest finite training NLL among accepted starts

quantile_ties: Stable score sort after canonical match_id/pass_id/frame_end ordering; equal-score plateau membership depends on this convention.
